quandoUsar: An assistant's prompt box: grows with the text, sends with Enter and inserts a line break with Shift + Enter.
Replies that can be interrupted: with `running`, the send button becomes a stop button in the same place.
Requests with attachments as chips and a menu to choose the model, all inside the same box.
quandoEvitar: Use `textarea` for a multi-line field in a form, with no send on Enter or stop button.
Use `mention-input` when the text needs mentions of people with @ or channels with #.
Use `chat-app` when you want the whole chat screen, with conversation, streaming replies and prompt box already wired up.

teclado.acao: In the text box, sends when there is text or an attachment; during IME composition it does not send.
Inserts a line break without sending; the box grows up to `maxRows` rows and then scrolls internally.
On the model selector, opens the menu with focus on the first model.
In the menu, moves between models; the arrows wrap from the last to the first.
In the menu, chooses the focused model, closes the menu and returns focus to the selector.
Closes the menu without changing the model and returns focus to the selector.

acessibilidade: The text box is named by `label` (default “Prompt”) and has the hidden description “Press Enter to send, Shift and Enter for a new line.” via `aria-describedby`; the visible hint is `aria-hidden`.
The icon-only buttons have a fixed English `aria-label` (“Attach files”, “Remove …”, “Send prompt”, “Stop response”), the selector announces itself as “Model: …” and the menu is a Radix radio group.
After sending, focus returns to the text box; send and stop are the same `<button>`, which only changes its `aria-label`, and stop is disabled without `onStop`.
movimento: The box follows the text height with a short spring; the attachment tray opens to its own height, each chip enters growing and the others slide when one leaves.
When `running` becomes `true`, the arrow leaves upward, a stop square grows in its place and an arc spins around the button; the model name swaps by sliding vertically.
With “reduce motion” on, the height changes instantly, chips and icons only fade, the arc stops and the menu appears with a quick fade.
responsivo: It is a width container: below 22rem the “Enter to send” hint disappears; the model name truncates with an ellipsis, and so does each attachment name, from 11rem.
The model menu opens above the selector, at least 15rem wide, and Radix repositions it to fit on screen, with 12 px of clearance.
notasIA: Wire up `onSubmit`, which receives the already-trimmed `value`, `attachments` and `model`, and control `running` with `onStop`; without `onStop`, the stop button is disabled during the reply.
Without `onAttach`, the button opens the system picker and creates chips with only name and size, without keeping the `File`; to actually send files, pass `onAttach` and control `attachments`.
By default, text and attachments are cleared after sending (`clearOnSubmit`); with empty `models` the menu disappears, and `model` with `onModelChange` makes the choice controlled.
